subject.title: fix(agent-runtime): skip unreadable allowlist tool names

question: Which open descriptor-hardening draft should own the shared readable-descriptor boundary for embedded agent tools?
rationale: Several open maintainer drafts overlap on unreadable tool metadata, and this PR fixes only one consumer while adjacent runtime consumers still dereference the same metadata directly.

options.title: Use one shared boundary
options.body: Choose or create the draft that snapshots readable local and client descriptors once and passes that shape to all embedded-runner consumers.

options.title: Land this narrow guard
options.body: Accept that allowlist collection improves while conversion, conflict, Tool Search, and reservation paths remain separate follow-ups.

options.title: Close after a replacement lands
options.body: If another PR becomes the canonical descriptor-boundary fix, close this draft only after that replacement is merged or clearly viable.

recommendation.title: Use one shared boundary
recommendation.body: Choose or create the draft that snapshots readable local and client descriptors once and passes that shape to all embedded-runner consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored and is assigned to this draft and authored the related open descriptor-hardening drafts found by live search.
